description: Fixtures for the v0.5 MessagePack trace decoder. Each case's expected value is what the trace-agent's receiver decodes from the body: decodeConvertedTracerPayload on /v0.5/traces (UnmarshalMsgDictionary), with no tracer headers and no container. A payload lists its chunks and spans in order; attribute maps are unordered. Doubles are Go's shortest formatting of the float64. Errors are classified as httpDecodingError tags them (tag) and as handleTracesV1 counts the dropped traces (reason). Generated by test/trace-agent-oracle/regenerate.sh; don't edit by hand.
